summary: CEMEX filed a 6-K announcing the full redemption of $1.0B 5.125% Subordinated Notes due 2021 at par plus accrued interest on June 26, 2026, funded via its new $3.0B 2026 revolver or cash. Separately, it used proceeds from its 5.750% Senior Notes due 2036 to repay $1.0B term loans under its 2023 credit agreement and €450M under its 2022 credit agreement, terminating those facilities and releasing subsidiary guarantees on secured notes (collateral released in 2021). The moves refinance near-term debt and simplify the capital structure. Watch for credit rating impact and any further liability management.
